mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly CPIAUCSL inflation index above 0.3% in a month coincides with a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to market anticipation of rate cuts.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically positive (p > 0.05) during such inflation spikes, or CPIAUCSL does not exceed 0.3 in any month during the test window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS employment exceeds 10,000 jobs while UNRATE falls below 4%, signaling labor market strengthening that boosts equity valuations and drives positive 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month +10,000 AND UNRATE < previous month - 0.5%
failure_condition: Over the 60-day horizon, SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (Rank IC < 0.05) during such labor market events.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in GDPC1 personal consumption exceeding 2% of the prior month's value, without a corresponding drop in INDPRO supply, predicts positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as demand outpaces supply.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1 previous month * 1.02 AND INDPRO < INDPRO previous month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative or flat during such demand-supply imbalances (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (≥ 2% over three months) accompanied by no significant drop in HOUST housing starts predicts negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as weak manufacturing and housing dampen growth expectations.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases ≥ 2% over 3 months AND HOUST > previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such supply contractions.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS rises above 5% for two consecutive months, the S&P 20-day forward return turns negative as higher policy rates depress risk appetite.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or flat during such episodes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in UNRATE below 4% in a month coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as lower unemployment is interpreted as a growth catalyst.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive during such UNRATE declines (Rank IC < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS retail sales miss below -2% followed by a rebound above 0% in the next month predicts a positive 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates recovery.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < previous month - 2% AND RSAFS > next month 0%
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative during such rebound episodes (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of falling INDPRO (≥ 1% decline each) without a parallel rise in GDPC1 personal consumption predict negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as supply contraction persists.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases ≥ 1% for two consecutive months AND GDPC1 < previous month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during such episodes.
